overview.description: The Hedgeye Hedged Bitcoin ETF (HBIT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund uses a fund-of-funds approach to providing exposure to Bitcoin, combined with an actively managed options strategy. The ETF holds iShares Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) and uses proprietary technical signals to reduce volatility and manage downside risk. HBIT was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Hedgeye.
